appDescription.message: A gentle daily quota for casual browsing — gentler than a Pomodoro timer. Reminds, never blocks.

appName.description: Extension name, same in all languages.

notifyLimitReached.description: System notification when the daily quota is first reached.
notifyLimitReached.message: Your casual browsing time today has reached $minutes$ minutes. Just a reminder — nothing is blocked.

notifyOverQuota.description: System notification when opening a new page after quota is reached.
notifyOverQuota.message: You've browsed for $used$ minutes today, $over$ minutes over your quota

optionsDailyQuotaHint.message: Daily cap on casual browsing time (minutes). Only reminds when reached — never blocks access.

optionsDailyQuotaLabel.description: Options: label for the quota number input.

optionsDomainHint.description: Options: hint under the domain whitelist heading.
optionsDomainHint.message: These sites don't count toward browsing time (e.g. chatgpt.com, 192.168.31.0/24). Localhost addresses are exempt by default.

optionsDomainPlaceholder.description: Options: placeholder of the domain input.

optionsKeywordHint.description: Options: hint under the title keywords heading.
optionsKeywordHint.message: Pages whose title contains any keyword are not timed (e.g. Blender); case-insensitive.

optionsKeywordPlaceholder.description: Options: placeholder of the keyword input.

optionsRemove.description: Options: remove button on each whitelist/keyword row.
